  label: string;
  closeLabel: string;
  active?: boolean;
  preview?: boolean;
  class?: string;

<script setup lang="ts">

  label,
  closeLabel,
  active = false,
  preview = false,
  class: className,

const emit = defineEmits<{ click: [], close: [] }>();

      'border-r border-border',

    :tabindex="(active ? 0 : -1)"

    @click="() => emit('click')"

      <slot name="icon" />

      <Button
        variant="ghost"
        size="sm"
        layout="icon"
        :class="'p-0 [&>svg]:size-4'"
